summary_linkedin.text:
I design and build large-scale systems end to end, from enterprise strategy and architecture to production code and delivery.

My background is engineering. I started in telecom and card processing, grew into leading backend and card-processing teams at Azerbaijan's largest private bank, and moved into architecture: the digital transformation programs of Azerbaijan's national railway, and today regional technical advisory for banks across CEMEA at Visa.

What I do best:
• Take an initiative from an idea to production: concept, target architecture, technology and vendor choices, team setup, delivery oversight
• Design distributed, event-driven and integration-heavy systems for banking and payments
• Align business strategy with technology: roadmaps, architecture principles, governance
• Build and lead engineering teams that ship

I choose languages and tools by what fits the problem, not by habit, and use AI-assisted development as a normal part of engineering work.

Domains: banking, payments and card processing, telecom, public sector.
Certifications: TOGAF Enterprise Architecture Practitioner, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, PMP, ITIL Foundation.
